info.title: Orchestration
info.description:
Provides methods to:
 * Monitor planning tasks created when errors occur during orchestration planning and retrigger the tasks for troubleshooting purposes.
 * Retrieve fulfillment requests created as a result of orchestration planning. Retrigger key mapping for pending fulfillment requests, and if key mapping exists, then orchestration execution begins by creating and triggering dispatch tasks.
 * Monitor dispatch tasks and retrigger them for troubleshooting purposes.
 * Send the order confirmation from a fulfillment system, such as SAP S/4HANA Cloud, to SAP Order Management foundation.

put.description:
Retrigger one or more dispatch tasks that contain an error and restart the transfer process. You can retrigger a maximum of 500 tasks in one request.
For important information about retriggering dispatch tasks, see [Monitoring and Troubleshooting Dispatch Tasks](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_Order_Management_Foundation/d91676a7fa624c31b7b1c526d7787e2f/1ab467ba65d34cfc982b13b4c2c4e1ea.html?locale=en-US&version=Cloud) on SAP Help Portal.

put.summary: Send the order confirmation to SAP Order Management foundation.
put.description:
Send the confirmation from the fulfillment system to SAP Order Management foundation. Note that one of the following must be present in the request to allow the system to set the dispatch task to SUCCESSFUL:
  • documentNumber
  • documentId
For example, you can provide the ID of the sales order from your fulfillment system. Note that if both of these values are missing from the request, the dispatch task will be set to FAILED.

The date on which the full shipment is expected to be shipped.

value.description:
Deprecated as of 2024-01-24. Use the 'value' parameter in the 'orderItems' array instead.

The quantity of an item ordered. The number can be an integer or a decimal (for example, 1 or 1.5 tons). A maximum of 10 digits is allowed before the decimal point, and a maximum of three digits (decimal places) is allowed after.

unit.description:
Deprecated as of 2024-01-24. Use the 'unit' parameter in the 'orderItems' array instead.

The code for the unit of measure in which typically the stock of a product is managed.

subscriptionItem.description: The information for a subscription item in an order.

numberOfWaiverPeriods.description: The number of billing cycles for which recurring charges are waived after the start of the subscription.

validFrom.description: The start of the validity period for subscription items.

validTo.description: The end of the validity period for subscription items.

contractTerm.description: The information for the contract term for a subscription item. This represents the minimum contract term of the subscription. During the minimum term, the subscription cannot be canceled.

period.description: The period of the minimum contract term in months.

endDate.description: The end date of the minimum contract term for a subscription item.

renewalTerm.description: The period by which the subscription automatically extends after the minimum contract term.

period.description: The length of the renewal term in months.

allowMidBillCycleExpiration.description: The flag to determine whether a subscription may expire in the middle of a billing cycle.

termOfNotice.description: The period of time to be observed if a customer wants to cancel a subscription.

overwriteContractTerm.description: The flag to determine whether the subscription terms predefined in the product can be overwritten.

sourcing.description: The sourcing-related information for an order.

shipments.description: The shipment information for the order.

fulfillmentSite.description: The site from which the order items will be shipped to the customer.

id.description: The unique identifier of the fulfillment site.

dropShipId.description: The vendor ID for the fulfillment site when drop-ship delivery is used.

delivery.description: The delivery-related information for the order.

deliveryOption.description: The delivery option applicable to the order.

expectedDeliveryDate.description: The date on which the full shipment is expected to be delivered.

expectedShippingDate.description: The date on which the full shipment is expected to be shipped.

customFields.description: Customized shipping-related data in the format of a JSON object.

reservation.description: The reservation-related information for the shipment.

id.description: The unique identifier of the reservation.

items.description: The products to be shipped to the customer. Each shipment item has a corresponding order item within the order, and vice versa.

referenceId.description: The unique ID for the order item in the external order capture system (for example, a Web shop) in which the order was originally placed. This must match the order item reference ID within the order item list.

value.description: The quantity of an item ordered. The number can be an integer or a decimal (for example, 1 or 1.5 tons). A maximum of 10 digits is allowed before the decimal point, and a maximum of three digits (decimal places) is allowed after.

unit.description: The code for the unit of measure in which typically the stock of a product is managed.

customFields.description: Customized data in the format of a JSON object for an order.

aspectsData.description: Deprecated as of 2024-01-24. Use the 'shipment' object instead.

orderItemDisplayId.description: The display ID of the order item.

displayId.description: The display ID of the fulfillment request item.

value.description: The quantity of the fulfillment request item.

unit.description: The code for the unit of measure of the fulfillment request item.

status.description: The status of the fulfillment request item.

createdAt.description: The date and time at which the fulfillment request item was added to the fulfillment request.

modifiedAt.description: The date and time at which the fulfillment request item was modified.

fulfillmentRequestRetriggerRequest.description:
A list of fulfillment requests to retrigger.

Maximum 1MB bytes body.

id.description: The ID of the fulfillment request to retrigger.

action.description: The action to take on the fulfillment request.

fulfillmentRequestRetriggerResponse.description: A list of fulfillment requests for which retriggering was requested.

id.description: The ID of the retriggered fulfillment request.

triggered.description: Whether the fulfillment request was retriggered.

triggeredAt.description: The date and time at which the fulfillment request was retriggered.

message.description: Detailed information about the retriggered fulfillment request in case of failure.
message.example: Enter a valid fulfillment request ID and ensure that the fulfillment request is in the 'PENDING' status.

multiplePlanningTaskReadResponse.description: A list of retrieved planning tasks.

orderDisplayId.description: The display ID of the order.

failedReason.description: The reason the orchestration planning failed.

createdAt.description: The date and time at which the planning task was created.

modifiedAt.description: The date and time at which the planning task was modified.

singlePlanningTaskReadResponse.description: Detailed information for the planning task retrieved.

orderDisplayId.description: The display ID of the order.

failedReason.description: The reason the orchestration planning failed.

createdAt.description: The date and time at which the planning task was created.

modifiedAt.description: The date and time at which the planning task was modified.

planningTaskRetriggerRequest.description:
The planning task to retrigger.

Maximum 1MB bytes body.

planningTaskId.description: The ID of the planning task to retrigger.

triggeredAt.description: The date and time at which the planning task was triggered.

code.description: The technical code of the error.

items.description: The schema for the specific error.

code.description: The technical code of the error.

message.example: Missing mandatory configuration, process cannot continue.

multipleDispatchTaskReadResponse.description: The dispatch tasks were successfully retrieved.

singleDispatchTaskReadResponse.description: The dispatch task was successfully retrieved.

dispatchTaskRetriggerResponse.description: The dispatch tasks were successfully retriggered.

dispatchTaskConfirmResponse.description: The order confirmation message was successfully received, and the dispatch task was updated accordingly.

multipleFulfillmentRequestReadResponse.description: The fulfillment requests were successfully retrieved.

singleFulfillmentRequestReadResponse.description: The fulfillment request was successfully retrieved.

fulfillmentRequestRetriggerResponse.description: The request to retrigger fulfillment requests was successful.

multiplePlanningTaskReadResponse.description: The planning tasks were successfully retrieved.

singlePlanningTaskReadResponse.description: The planning task was successfully retrieved.

planningTaskRetriggerResponse.description: The planning task was successfully retriggered.

400.description:
Your input data is not valid or is not in a consistent format. Please check it and try again.
You can also check the response payload for more information.

404.description:
No results were found. If you provided parameters, ensure that they are valid.
You can also check the response payload for more information.

413.description: The maximum request payload size has been exceeded.

500.description: There was an error on the server side. If the problem persists, please report the error as described by SAP.

oauth2.description:
To use this API, you need to obtain the OAuth client credentials (client ID and secret) using the SAP BTP cockpit. After that, pass these client credentials to the SAP BTP token endpoint to obtain an access token.
For more information, see the Service Guide.

scopes.{identityzone}.DispatchView: View dispatch tasks and order item statuses.
scopes.{identityzone}.DispatchManage: Manage dispatch tasks by retriggering them.
scopes.{identityzone}.DispatchIntegrate: Integrate with your fulfillment system (e.g. Receive fulfillment confirmation and order item statuses).

x-sap-shortText: Enables you to orchestrate orders between SAP Order Management foundation and your fulfillment system.
